qt: to the Commission Borja Giménez Larraz (PPE), Dolors Montserrat (PPE), Isabel Benjumea Benjumea (PPE) Subject:

The European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO) has launched two investigations into suspected fraud involving EU funds allocated to maintaining and modernising the MadridSeville line. These investigations come in the wake of the serious rail accidents in Adamuz and Urda, substandard execution of works and doubts over how the projects are being managed. At the end of 2025, the Ministry of Transport had yet to implement EUR 1.196 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), representing 61.8 % of the allocated funds. Furthermore, the Court of Auditors had already flagged shortcomings in ADIF’s management and control system, particularly regarding the audit trail for funded operations and the prevention of conflicts of interest. In light of the above: 1.
What explanations has the Commission requested from the Spanish Government concerning the high volume of unimplemented EU funds and the management shortcomings identified by the Court of Auditors?

Has it demanded specific corrective measures, as well as the identification of those responsible for these shortcomings, particularly as regards the Madrid-Seville line modernisation contracts currently under investigation?

In view of the investigations, does the Commission consider it necessary to review the reliability of the management declarations and supporting information submitted by the Spanish authorities to account for the use of EU funds?
